description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Ratio” (x-axis, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale with tick marks at 0.2 intervals) and the “minADE₂₀ (←)” metric (y-axis, ranging from 0.55 to 0.75 in linear scale with tick marks at 0.05 intervals), comparing four different model adaptation strategies: Head Tuning (blue line with circle markers, solid), FT (green line with circle markers, solid), LoRA 16 (red line with circle markers, solid), and LoRA 64 (purple line with circle markers, solid). Head Tuning remains relatively flat across the ratio range, starting at approximately 0.61 at ratio 0.0 and ending near 0.59 at ratio 1.0. FT shows a steep decline from about 0.68 at ratio 0.0 to 0.53 at ratio 1.0. LoRA 16 begins at 0.74 at ratio 0.0, decreases to 0.61 at ratio 0.6, then slightly rises to 0.60 at ratio 1.0. LoRA 64 starts at 0.75 at ratio 0.0, declines steadily to 0.60 at ratio 0.8, and ends at 0.60 at ratio 1.0. The orange line with circle markers, labeled “Head Tuning” in the legend, appears to be mislabeled in the plot — visually, it corresponds to a separate, unlabeled curve that starts at 0.79 at ratio 0.0 and declines to 0.68 at ratio 1.0, suggesting a possible labeling error in the legend or plot.
